title: ICE Wants Agents to Have Electric-Shock Gloves for Detainees
title_cn: ICE 希望特工为被拘留者配备电击手套
summary: Federal immigration agents are looking to buy gloves that can inflict electric shocks on detainees as President Donald Trump intensifies his mass arrest and deportation drive.

title: DOJ Lawyer Evades Ethics Sanction Over Journalist’s Home Search
title_cn: 美国司法部律师逃避对记者家庭搜查的道德制裁
summary: A longtime Justice Department attorney will not face disciplinary action from the Virginia State Bar after a federal judge admonished his conduct in seeking a search warrant against a Washington Post reporter.

title: Iran Takes More Robust Military Stance With US Talks Frozen
title_cn: 美国谈判冻结，伊朗采取更强硬的军事立场
summary: Iran has reorganized its military to be more aggressive abroad as talks on ending the war with the US remain mired in stalemate, a sign that Tehran is preparing for a protracted era of regional conflict.

title: Big Bend Park Is Set to Get Border Barriers Even Trump Fans Hate
title_cn: 大弯公园将设置边境屏障，连特朗普的粉丝都讨厌
summary: The Trump administration has moved heavy-duty construction equipment into Big Bend National Park and started work on a border security project despite bipartisan concern about damage to the environmentally sensitive area of West Texas.
